g0.text: God is smiling over you.. Not tolerating you. Not putting up with you. Rejoicing over you, out loud, with singing. ... The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.. Zephaniah 3, verse 17. ... Think on this. When did you last let yourself be delighted in?

Worry is a prayer pointed the wrong way.. Turn the same energy toward heaven, and add thank you. Peace follows that you can't explain. ... Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.. Philippians 4, verse 6-7. ... Think on this. What worry can you hand over right now, by name?

Change your mind, change your life.. Transformation starts on the inside. Renew the thoughts, and the path follows. ... And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind,. Romans 12, verse 2. ... Think on this. What thought have you been repeating that isn't true?

Too young? Not to God.. Your age doesn't cancel your example. ... Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.. 1 Timothy 4, verse 12. ... Think on this. How can you lead by example this week?

g1.text: The hand is already reaching for you.. You don't have to climb out alone. He's not waiting at the top. He came down to where you are. ... Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.. Isaiah 41, verse 10. ... Think on this. What would you put down if you knew someone was holding you up?

Broken is not the end of the story.. He doesn't keep his distance from heartbreak. He draws closest there. ... The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.. Psalm 34, verse 18. ... Think on this. Where do you need God close today?

Seek Him first.. Put Him at the top of the list, and watch the rest of the list get rearranged. ... But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.. Matthew 6, verse 33. ... Think on this. What's been sitting in first place instead?

Jehovah: the name above every name.. Jehovah is God's own covenant name, the One who was, and is, and always will be. He first made it known to Moses in Exodus 6:3, and Psalm 83 says it belongs to Him alone. ... That men may know that thou, whose name alone is Jehovah, art the most high over all the earth.. Psalm 83, verse 18. ... Think on this. What does it mean to you that God told us His own name?

g2.text: Look up. Someone painted this for you.. Every sunrise is a signature. The same hands that stretched out the sky formed you. ... The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.. Psalm 19, verse 1. ... Think on this. What did you see today that only God could make?

Rest is not quitting.. Even the One who made the world rested. Weary is an invitation, not a failure. ... Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.. Matthew 11, verse 28. ... Think on this. What would real rest look like for you this week?

Love is patient.. Real love isn't a feeling that comes and goes. It's a choice you make on the hard days. ... Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,. 1 Corinthians 13, verse 4. ... Think on this. Where can you be more patient with someone you love?

Soft words turn the heat down.. When someone comes at you hot, a gentle answer cools the room. A harsh word pours gas on the fire. You get to choose which one you hand them. ... A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.. Proverbs 15, verse 1. ... Think on this. Who do you need to answer softly this week?

g3.text: Yesterday is not the boss of today.. Mercy didn't run out overnight. It refilled while you slept. ... It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.. Lamentations 3, verse 22-23. ... Think on this. What do you need a fresh start on this morning?

You don't need the whole map.. Just the next step. Trust lights the path one footprint at a time. ... Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.. Proverbs 3, verse 5-6. ... Think on this. What's one next step you already know to take?

Train them up.. What you plant now grows with them for the rest of their lives. ... Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.. Proverbs 22, verse 6. ... Think on this. What do you want your children to remember about your faith?

What charity really is.. In the King James Bible, charity means love that gives itself away. It is God's own kind of love put into action. It is bigger than a donation. It is a heart that moves toward people. ... And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.. 1 Corinthians 13, verse 13. ... Think on this. Where is God asking your love to move toward someone?

g4.text: Slow progress is still progress.. Eagles don't flap harder. They wait for the wind, then rise. Walking without fainting is a victory too. ... But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.. Isaiah 40, verse 31. ... Think on this. Where are you trying to fly when God is asking you to walk?

Your work is worship.. The dishes, the shift, the homework, the hard conversation. Do it like He's the one watching. ... And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;. Colossians 3, verse 23. ... Think on this. What ordinary task could become an offering today?

Forgive like you've been forgiven.. Forgiveness doesn't excuse what happened. It frees you from carrying it. ... And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.. Ephesians 4, verse 32. ... Think on this. Who do you need to release?

Be strong in the Lord.. Before Paul names one piece of armor, he tells you where the strength comes from. Not your grit. His might. The armor only works on someone leaning on Him. ... Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.. Ephesians 6, verse 10. ... Think on this. Whose strength have you been running on this week?

g5.text: You were never meant to carry it alone.. Strength isn't hiding the fall. Strength is letting someone help you up. ... Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.. Ecclesiastes 4, verse 9-10. ... Think on this. Who could you text today just to say, I'm here?

Your body is holy ground.. Water, sleep, a walk, a meal that loves you back. Caring for the temple is spiritual. ... What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?. 1 Corinthians 6, verse 19. ... Think on this. What's one kind thing you can do for your body today?

Ask. Seek. Knock.. God isn't annoyed by your asking. He invites it. ... Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:. Matthew 7, verse 7. ... Think on this. What have you stopped asking for?
